critical_code_review_comments: server.py:341 uses `logger.warning(...)` but `logger` is defined further down at line 433. Works at runtime because module-level code runs before requests, but visually confusing — move `logging.basicConfig` + `logger = getLogger` to the top of the file (right after imports).

server.py: silent-backfill loop at lines 344-348 (`for m in eff_names + fair_names: if m not in metrics: fallback = generate_metrics(...); metrics[m] = fallback.get(m, 0.0)`) is a genuine silent fallback path with NO log message. Requested P2 fix asked to log warnings on 'silent fairness-metric fallbacks' — training.py now does but server.py does not. Consider logging a warning here so demo runs are transparent when the returned metric came from mock generate_metrics rather than fairlearn (e.g. the regression + Equalized Odds Difference case).

server.py /api/datasets/upload: no size/row limit is enforced beyond nrows=5000 in pd.read_csv — but the raw bytes are read first (`raw = await file.read()`), so a multi-GB upload will exhaust RAM before pandas caps at 5k rows. Add UploadFile.spool + file.size guard or stream via file.file in a bounded chunk read.

server.py /api/datasets/upload stores the ENTIRE parsed dataset (up to 5k rows) inside the Mongo document. This will hit the 16MB BSON document limit on wide/long CSVs. Consider chunking rows into a subcollection keyed by dataset_id, or capping (columns × rows) more aggressively.

training.py load_dataset_from_records tries `pd.to_numeric(df[col])` on every column with a bare `except (ValueError, TypeError)`. If the CSV has mixed-type columns (e.g., a column that is mostly numeric but has 1 stray string), the whole column stays as object — silently. Consider `pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')` and then filling NaN, or logging the count of failed coercions.

training.py: warning coverage for silent fallbacks is now good (fairness metric except -> logger.warning; Reweighing/DEMV sample_weight TypeError -> warning; ExponentiatedGradient/ThresholdOptimizer failure -> warning). One remaining silent branch: line 466-469 the `except Exception: y_pred = model.predict(X_test_arr); y_proba = None` swallows without logging.

ResultsPage.jsx download-csv-btn and download-model-btn are still mocked (toast only) as flagged in mocked_apis — visible to end users as buttons; consider a subtle 'prototype' pill next to them or disabling them until the real endpoints exist.

index.css @media print block hides `.App > .sticky` — this depends on the App shell class being '.App' with a sticky child; fragile if the shell CSS class ever changes. Adding data-print='hide' to the shell nav would be more robust than the CSS selector.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all TEST_ experiments and uploaded CSVs created during test runs were cleaned up.
